title: A look at Kioxia, the Japanese NAND flash maker that went from being cash-strapped in 2023 to an expected 30-fold jump in operating income in Q1 FY 2026 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: A look at Kioxia, the Japanese NAND flash maker that went from being cash-strapped in 2023 to an expected 30-fold jump in operating income in Q1 FY 2026 — The chipmaker needs to prove it's more than an accidental beneficiary of a supply squeeze in storage.
